summary: Frontend E2E test (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080) of S32 features on Magasin TEST only: Corbeille (request deletion w/ reason, direction-only tab, restore, hard delete w/ MOUR1), 'Pris en charge' checkbox, 3-button 'est-il venu ?' flow + new 'Non' callback choices, PrisEnChargeFlow (group 10, 7-day guard), CallLogPanel callback choices unchanged, 'pas de réponse' call logging. ALL 13 requested scenarios PASSED. Only 2 TEST leads created (store=test), both deleted at the end.

issues: Title 'Admin Repair&Co' (h1 in header, AdminPage.jsx ~l.760) is invisible: computed color rgb(26,92,58) on bg #1A5C3A (global h1 color overrides text-white of parent). Add text-white directly on the h1. Probably pre-existing, not S32.
Once 'Non' is clicked there is no 'Retour/Annuler' to get back to the 3 buttons (only a tab switch resets the view). Misclick = stuck. Consider a small Retour link.
'1 demandes' plural not handled (minor French grammar).
